items.title: Breaking: Woman who attacked Senator Lidia Thorpe outside the MCG avoids jail
items.description: Lidia Thorpe was with a group of friends near the stadium after the Dreamtime at the G game between Essendon and Richmond when she was attacked by Ebony Jan Bell.

items.title: Meeting to decide Moira Deeming's future cancelled amid court battle
items.description: Victorian MP Moira Deeming has won a two-week reprieve as a Liberal candidate for the November state election, after the party agreed in the Supreme Court to cancel imminent plans to revoke her preselection.

items.title: West Coast star Adam Hunter's 'grieving best mate' slams AFL leadership
items.description: In a five-page letter to the executives and commissioners of the AFL, a grieving best mate has slammed the organisation for "failing" former West Coasts player Adam Hunter, who suffered from CTE.

items.title: 'Panicked' Putin has big decision to make, and 'could go nuclear'
items.description: The Russian president's decision to annex Crimea showed the world his authoritarian muscle. These days, it is a "personal humiliation".

items.title: Suspected bird flu cases detected in NSW and WA after devastating impact overseas
items.description: A suspected positive case of H5 bird flu has been identified in New South Wales, the state agriculture minister has announced.

items.title: Photos show site of US pilot's killing at hands of Papua rebels
items.description: A Papua separatist group has shot dead an American pilot who allegedly transported Indonesian troops into the restive province.

items.title: Widow warns of shock ambulance bill after husband's unexpected death
items.description: Private health insurers can legally avoid ambulance bills because corpses are not considered patients, a loophole that left a grieving widow shocked.

items.title: Pub for breakfast: How World Cup watch parties took over Australia
items.description: They were just supposed to be somewhere to watch the match, but World Cup viewing parties have ended up becoming so much more.

items.title: For decades Australian house prices have grown. This is what a fall could mean
items.description: After decades of growth, Australian house prices are slowing. Here's what a fall could look like.

items.title: Man who spent eight days stuck under collapsed shopping centre in Venezuela rescued alive
items.description: Hernan Alberto Gil Flores, a 43-year-old Venezuelan man was dug out alive from under the ruins of a collapsed shopping centre, eight days after devastating earthquakes shook the nation.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
